newsitem.title: USA: Janex Int'l chief executive resigns.
newsitem.headline: Janex Int'l chief executive resigns.

text.p: Janex International Inc on Monday said Sheldon Morick resigned as president and chief executive for personal reasons.

In a statement, the company said Leslie Friedland, the former co-owner of Janex, agreed to serve as president/chief executive officer and as a director at no salary for the balance of 1997. His compensation, beginning January 1, 1998, has yet to be determined.
The company, which makes products for children, also said it intended to move its headquarters to Eatontown, N.J.

Dan Lesnick, also a former co-owner of Janex, has agreed to serve as executive vice president and chief operating officer at no salary for the rest of the year. Lesnick's salary, effective January 1, has yet to be determined.
Separately, the company said three major debt holders of the company will postpone notes due February 1, 1998, to February 1, 1999, and interest due on these notes will accrue.

Janex said it planned to take write-offs pertaining to goodwill and underperforming licenses. As a result of the write-offs and other steps, the company believes it can substantially reduce its operating costs.
